"import csv
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches

# Read CSV data
data = []
with open('perf_02.csv', 'r') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        data.append(row)

# Extract numeric columns
cl_max_values = [float(row['cl_max']) for row in data]
cd_cruise_values = [float(row['cd_cruise']) for row in data]
ld_ratio_values = [float(row['ld_ratio']) for row in data]

# Compute required statistics
cl_max_max = max(cl_max_values)
cd_cruise_mean = sum(cd_cruise_values) / len(cd_cruise_values)
ld_ratio_mean = sum(ld_ratio_values) / len(ld_ratio_values)

# Find best config (max L/D)
max_ld_value = max(ld_ratio_values)
best_config = None
for row in data:
    if float(row['ld_ratio']) == max_ld_value:
        best_config = row['config']
        break

# Round to required display precision
cl_max_display = round(cl_max_max, 3)
cd_cruise_display = round(cd_cruise_mean, 4)
ld_ratio_display = round(ld_ratio_mean, 1)

# Create presentation
prs = Presentation()

# Slide 1: Title
slide1 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[0])
slide1.shapes.title.text = "Aerodynamic Performance Report"
slide1.placeholders[1].text = "Analysis of perf_02.csv"

# Slide 2: Data table
slide2 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[5])
slide2.shapes.title.text = "Data"

num_rows = len(data) + 1  # header + data rows
num_cols = 4
left = Inches(0.5)
top = Inches(1.5)
width = Inches(9.0)
height = Inches(0.4 * num_rows)

table_shape = slide2.shapes.add_table(num_rows, num_cols, left, top, width, height)
table = table_shape.table

# Header row
headers = ['config', 'cl_max', 'cd_cruise', 'ld_ratio']
for col_idx, header in enumerate(headers):
    table.cell(0, col_idx).text = header

# Data rows
for row_idx, row_data in enumerate(data, start=1):
    table.cell(row_idx, 0).text = str(row_data['config'])
    table.cell(row_idx, 1).text = str(row_data['cl_max'])
    table.cell(row_idx, 2).text = str(row_data['cd_cruise'])
    table.cell(row_idx, 3).text = str(row_data['ld_ratio'])

# Slide 3: Summary
slide3 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[1])
slide3.shapes.title.text = "Summary"

tf3 = slide3.placeholders[1].text_frame
tf3.text = f"CLmax max = {cl_max_display}"

p = tf3.add_paragraph()
p.text = f"CDcruise mean = {cd_cruise_display}"

p = tf3.add_paragraph()
p.text = f"L/D mean = {ld_ratio_display}"

p = tf3.add_paragraph()
p.text = f"best config (max L/D) = {best_config}"

# Slide 4: Next steps
slide4 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[1])
slide4.shapes.title.text = "Next Steps"
tf4 = slide4.placeholders[1].text_frame
tf4.text = "Review the data and proceed with further aerodynamic optimization studies."

prs.save('report.pptx')"
